verdict.rationale: BugSnag publishes a first-party OpenAPI 3.0.3 document for its Data Access API on SwaggerHub at a downloadable swagger.json URL. The developer portal's Data Access API reference is generated from that spec and has pages on authentication, pagination, rate limiting and versioning. The probe 404s only show the spec is not hosted at conventional paths on docs.bugsnag.com, which does not contradict the SwaggerHub publication. Missing for 10: no independent or hands-on corroboration of downloading and using the spec, and the spec is not discoverable at conventional well-known/openapi.json paths on the docs domain.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
